name: NE5532
description: High-performance dual bipolar-input operational amplifier optimized for audio. Features very low equivalent input noise voltage (5 nV/rtHz typ at 1 kHz), high output-drive capability, low distortion, and a 12 MHz unity-gain bandwidth. Internally compensated for unity-gain operation, with input-protection diodes and output short-circuit protection.

pins.name: VCC-
pins.description: Negative supply rail (or GND in single-supply use)

extra.Vos: 0.5mV typ (4mV max) @ Ta=25C (5mV max full range)
extra.Ibias: 200nA typ (800nA max) @ Ta=25C (1000nA max full range)

typical_application: Low-noise audio preamps, active filters, mixing-console gain stages, and DAC output buffers.
gotchas: bipolar (BJT) input stage draws appreciable input bias current, so it is not ideal for very high-impedance sources the way the JFET-input TL082 is
decouple each supply rail close to the pin (e.g. 0.1 uF ceramic) to avoid oscillation given the wide bandwidth
needs a meaningful load/output current to deliver its rated audio performance; designed to drive low impedances
pin 4 is VCC- (negative rail), not ground, in split-supply designs
